Reference / mail/smtp

mail/smtp#

SMTP server capabilities: what an EHLO reply advertises (RFC 5321 §4.1.1.1).

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let capabilities = SmtpCapabilities(ehlo_reply);
capabilities.features().membership(SmtpFeature.start_tls);
capabilities.mechanisms();                         // ["PLAIN", "SCRAM-SHA-256"]
if capabilities.has_maximum_size() { capabilities.maximum_size(); }

Description#

SMTP server capabilities: what an EHLO reply advertises (RFC 5321 §4.1.1.1).

Built from a successful 250 reply; its first line is the greeting, not an extension. Keywords match without regard to ASCII case; unknown extensions and parameters are kept. SIZE absent, SIZE without a value and SIZE 0 stay distinct. A capability says what the server offers, not that TLS was verified; after STARTTLS a new EHLO needs new capabilities.
